subject.title: [Feature]: Dreaming: add wildcard candidates to deep phase ranking

question: Should memory-core Dreaming allow nondeterministic sub-threshold promotion, and if so should it be default-on, opt-in, or report-only?
rationale: The requested behavior changes durable memory curation and future context, so code inspection cannot decide the right safety/default/audit tradeoff without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Opt-in auditable wildcard lane
options.body: Add a disabled-by-default or explicitly configured wildcard lane that is applied consistently in rank/apply and reports why a sampled candidate was promoted.

options.title: Keep strict promotion gates
options.body: Leave Dreaming deterministic and threshold-gated unless a broader memory curation roadmap approves serendipity behavior.

options.title: Default-on sampling
options.body: Enable wildcard sampling by default for all Dreaming users, accepting nondeterministic durable-memory changes as product behavior.

recommendation.title: Opt-in auditable wildcard lane
recommendation.body: Add a disabled-by-default or explicitly configured wildcard lane that is applied consistently in rank/apply and reports why a sampled candidate was promoted.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged Dreaming promotion flow and are the clearest feature-history owner for the ranking policy.
